استجيزوا (form X)
# اُسْتُجِيزُوا (ustujīzū) /us.tu.d͡ʒiː.zuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَجَازَ (istajāza)
# اِسْتَجِيزُوا (istajīzū) /is.ta.d͡ʒiː.zuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَجَازَ (istajāza)
